item.title: Cork push clear of Meath at top of Division 2 as Louth record first win over Tyrone in 32 years
item.description: Louth put a serious dent in Tyrone's Allianz Football League Division 2 promotion hopes this afternoon by inflicting a 1-15 to 0-13 defeat on them in Ardee.

item.title: McDonald hits 1-4 on debut as Mayo crush Monaghan in Clones
item.description: Mayo recorded another impressive win in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League this afternoon by dishing out an emphatic 2-30 to 2-11 defeat to Monaghan in Clones this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Mulreany saves late Armagh penalty as Donegal preserve 100% league record
item.description: Donegal maintained their 100% record in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League by holding off Armagh's late charge for a 1-20 to 0-19 win at the BOX-IT Athletic Grounds this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's Allianz Football and Hurling League results and tables
item.description: Check out all of this afternoon's Allianz Football and Hurling fourth round results below...

item.title: Cruciate curse strikes Louth's Lynch
item.description: Louth defender Peter Lynch has been ruled out for the rest of the season after rupturing his ACL.

item.title: Cleary praises Cork players and fans as promotion beckons
item.description: John Cleary was full of praise for the Cork players and supporters after yesterday's Allianz Football League Division 2 victory over Meath.

item.title: 'We're delighted to get the points'
item.description: Jim McGuinness cut a contented figure after Donegal's 1-20 to 0-19 Allianz Football League Division 1 victory over old rivals Armagh at the BOX-IT Athletic Grounds.

item.title: Strong finish pleases O'Connor
item.description: Jack O'Connor feels Kerry have scope for improvement, despite overcoming old rivals Dublin by six points at Croke Park on Saturday night.

item.title: 'You never have them beaten until you're on the bus going home'
item.description: While acknowledging their never-say-die attitude, Peter Queally felt Kilkenny were fortunate to edge out his Waterford side in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League courtesy of a controversial late free from Cian Kenny.

item.title: Moran unsurprised by McDonald impact
item.description: Andy Moran wasn't surprised by Kobe McDonald's sensational debut performance for Mayo.
